message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: pytest

on: [push]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      max-parallel: 5
      matrix:
        # 3.12 is the default development version. 3.11 keeps the declared
        # lower bound in pyproject.toml covered by tests.
        python-version: ["3.12", "3.11"]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
    - name: Install uv
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    - name: Cache uv dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/uv
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock') }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-uv-${{ hashFiles('uv.lock') }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          ${{ runner.os }}-uv-
    - name: Install powergenome with dev dependencies
      run: |
        # --locked asserts uv.lock is up to date and installs exactly what it pins
        uv sync --extra dev --locked --python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    - name: Lint with flake8
      run: |
        uv pip install flake8
        # stop the build if there are Python syntax errors or undefined names.
        # Exclude .venv since uv creates it inside the workspace (the previous
        # micromamba environment lived outside the repo).
        uv run flake8 . --exclude=.venv --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
        # exit-zero treats all errors as warnings. The GitHub editor is 127 chars wide
        uv run flake8 . --exclude=.venv --count --exit-zero --max-complexity=10 --max-line-length=127 --statistics
    - name: Test with pytest
      env:
        PUDL_DB: ${{ secrets.PUDL_DB }}
        PG_DB: ${{ secrets.PG_DB }}
      run: |
        uv run pytest --cov=powergenome tests/ --cov-report=xml
    - name: Upload test coverage report to CodeCov
      uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
      env:
        CODECOV_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly downloads/installs Python dependencies via uv with a pinned uv.lock, matching the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-download caching pattern. The experiment evidence for dependency caching measured a 9.2% elapsed-time reduction with preserved test success. Adding an actions/cache step for ~/.cache/uv, keyed on uv.lock and matrix python-version, reuses dependency downloads across runs while invalidating when the lockfile or Python version changes. All existing steps (checkout, uv install, locked sync, flake8 lint, pytest with coverage, CodeCov upload) and secrets are preserved unchanged; no permissions are weakened and no new privileged actions, secrets, publishing, deployment, or network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
